native.scope: targeted regression, not full browser suite

output.independentRenderer: Poppler pdfinfo/pdftoppm; both pages visually inspected

fixesDuringVerification: Area sources now precede explicit frames so area order is preserved in publication.
Orthographic alignment no longer mistakes its own first join for a conflicting preexisting group.
Unreadable reference/caption candidates are rejected before scale selection, allowing a readable larger-scale multi-page candidate to win.
Per-instance clip paths prevent source text outside a frame crop from leaking onto neighboring drawings.
Regression found the new toolbar covered an existing frame editor label; toolbar moved to the shared top control row and native checks repeated.
Native test initial 3D mode was corrected to use the actual 2D switch.
limitations: Existing finite frame geometry and model-view adapters only; no general HLR/spline expansion.
PDF uses existing raster Worker export.
DXF sampled polylines/text; fills/dashes/colors/association omitted; partial or rotated text refuses output.
Same presentation plane and one scale divisor per set; no connected-group splitting or rotated packing.
Fixed groups keep existing local paper placements and require original paper/template/divisor.
fileGuards: Invalid or duplicate page numbers, source references, inconsistent set metadata, out-of-paper/overlapping placements, malformed saved link graph, and connected groups split across pages are rejected.
